LanguageData.SKCW.RelaxedWorksiteSpawningTooltip: Lets worksites try to appear almost anywhere as long as there is loot: farming sites ignore biomes that block farming, hunting ignores low animal counts, logging ignores low tree counts, and mining ignores flat or gentle terrain.
LanguageData.SKCW.SettingsRestartNotice: Changes will not take effect until you restart your game.
LanguageData.SKCW.ResetToDefaultsTooltip: Restore all worksite settings, including biome weights, to their original values.
LanguageData.SKCW.ConfigureBiomeWeightsTooltip: Higher weights make it more likely for worksites to spawn in this biome.
